And then another possible explanation was the military being involved. Yeah. And Sherman, this was actually his first thought. He thought the military is here and they're doing something. They're messing with us for some reason. Um, so actually some of the people involved took this quite seriously and NIDS checked it out too. Um, they weren't able to find any evidence that our military was doing this though. (1:01:34)

Um, you might say, well, why would the military want to do this to someone? One proposal that you might call the Scooby-Doo hypothesis. It's the classic thing that happens in Scooby-Doo. Someone wants to buy someone else's property and so they hoax weird stuff to drive the price down or to get someone to abandon their property. So maybe the military is doing a Scooby-Doo on the Shermans because they want the land. (1:01:57)

Problem is, why don't they just use imminent domain? There are lots of other situations where the government wants land and they just take it. They compensate you, but they take it. Um, this happened, this is notorious for happening around Area 51. Out in Nevada, there is a family, there's actually more than one, but there was a family that had a mining interest on the edge of Area 51. They'd been working this mine for like a hundred years in their family or something. (1:02:24)

Area 51 starts expanding, decides the mine is too close. They don't want these people looking at them. They take the land. And so the government, if the military just wanted this, wanted Skinwalker Ranch, they could have taken it through presumably any number of legal or quasi-legal means, including imminent domain. Plus, again, the long game, this isn't just during the 18 months that the Gormans owned this property. There's a long history in this location of the phenomenon. (1:02:52)

Right. Now, another reason that the government might want to do this is because they're doing an experiment. Maybe they're experimenting on the Shermans with all this stuff they're doing. (1:03:06)

How plausible is that? Well, it's somewhat... I mean, there's an initial surface level plausibility. We do know the government has experimented on people without their knowledge or consent. And we're going to be talking about that in future episodes. We're going to be talking about, for example, the MKULTRA project that the CIA ran that experimented on people. There are others as well, including medical experiments like the Tuskegee syphilis experiment, where the pretended to treat black men with syphilis and didn't to see what would happen. (1:03:41)

And that ran from 1932 to 1972. So within 20 years or so of these events, we know the government was also experimenting on people without their consent. So there is a surface level of plausibility, but here we've got a really small sample size. There's just this one family. And what are you trying to do as a result of this experiment? What's the point? What are you trying to prove? It's not like you're testing truth serums on these people like MKULTRA, where you have a definable goal. (1:04:16)

This is more like just messing with people. Now, you could say, well, it's a deception of some kind. Maybe it's part of UFO disinformation. And we know there are other cases, and we'll talk about these, like the Richard Bennewitz case, where the military has hoaxed UFO stuff to throw people off the trail of actual classified projects. Maybe that's going on here. Okay, well, then if it's just UFO disinformation, why not hoax a few UFOs? Why the whole range of stuff that's happening? And then lastly, if our military is responsible, how did they do all this in the 90s? Do we have this technology that could make things invisible and make blue orbs capable of incinerating dogs or tunnels in the sky? What technology exactly did we have in the 90s that could do this? Or today. (1:05:20)

Or today for some of that. Yeah. Although at least today we have an idea how we could do invisibility one day through metamaterials, but it's not there yet. And then there was, you mentioned the parallel world theory. Yeah. So, you know, if you say, I mean, you have kind of a basic choice of if you say the reported phenomena, not in all the details, but they're either basically correct. (1:05:44)

The accounts of all this stuff is either basically correct or basically incorrect. If it's basically correct, what best explains this? It seems to me the answer would be some kind of bridge to another world, either a parallel world in another dimension or another planet or this planet in another time or some combination of those. But the portals that they encountered, if those accounts are accurate, you could explain a lot of these other phenomena based on that. (1:06:23)

You can explain the unseen events based on the fact that you have somebody, perhaps someone else's military or our military in the future with invisibility technology. You can explain the advanced aircraft with the advanced technology. (1:06:40)

You could explain the orbs with advanced technology from another place. You could explain the weird animals as coming from another place. So it seems to me that the portal-like experiences really let you explain a lot of this if you think those are credible. If you don't think they're credible, then you have to look for another explanation like a hoax or a hallucination or a military experiment or something. (1:07:13)

But just to consider every possibility, if the portal experiences are credible, then my bet would be it's a bridge to another world. And specifically, since it seems earthly, it's got a blue sky, it has animals that are similar to ours, but different. I would think either our future or a parallel earth. So just taking... and I'm not... believe me, I'm not saying that's what this is. (1:07:41)

I'm just saying if you take the claims at face value, that is what they would seem to point to. So that brings us to the last one, which is, well, could it be some combination of these things? And the answer is, sure, maybe some things were hoaxed. Maybe some things were hallucinations. You know, the mental phenomena, I've already said those could all just be subjective misimpressions. (1:08:03)

Maybe the military was messing with people. Maybe, you know, it could be a combination of things. But simpler explanations are the ones to be preferred. And if you have a range of weird phenomena in a single place in a single time frame, rather than postulating multiple causes, you want to consider is there one cause that could explain all of it? So, Jimmy, what is your bottom line when it comes to all of this? I have no clue. (1:08:37)

It's, I mean, you know, the skeptic in me wants to say just dismiss the whole thing as hoax or hallucination or military disinformation. But it's hard to see how our military could do all of this. And it's hard to dismiss it all as hoax or hallucination, because NIDS got, you know, not a lot, but they got some of this on record. (1:08:56)

They took readings, they took video, and something was happening. You'd have to have the Gormans, NIDS, possibly the military, all these people in on the hoax together. For what purpose? For what purpose? So I do not know what's going on at Skinwalker Ranch or what has been going on. A surface reading of the evidence, at least as of the reports, would suggest parallel world involvement. (1:09:32)

But it's also really hard for me to say, oh, there's a parallel world, and it's been breaking through at Skinwalker Ranch. That's, in some ways, a solid conclusion for me, Jimmy, would be reassuring. But in some ways, having it open-ended is also very interesting and allows for lots of speculation. So if folks wanted to dig into this for themselves and to find out more, what are your further resources that you'd like to offer? So I have links to Wikipedia's entries on Skinwalker Ranch and on NIDS. I will have a link to the book Hunt for the Skinwalker, which, as I said, is by Tom Kelleher and George Knapp. So it's the most reputable book that there's going to be on this. (1:10:13)

There are other books, but these guys were pros who were involved in the situation. Also, there's the Jeremy Corbell documentary, also called Hunt for the Skinwalker, where you get to see some old reports of George Knapp's reporting on Skinwalker Ranch back in the 90s, as well as interviews with the NIDS scientists and a discussion of what's happening today, including a kind of disguised interview with the current owner. (1:10:35)

I have a link to the original Deseret or Desiree News article where the Gormans or the Shermans went public about this. There's also an amateur investigator site at SkinwalkerRanch.org that I'll have a link to. And then lastly, a Google Maps aerial view of Skinwalker Ranch so you can look at the place on Google Maps from their satellite perspective. (1:10:59)

That's Skinwalker Ranch, folks. Before we close out, of course, we want to do as you usually do. We want to go through some of your mysterious feedback. (1:11:03)

And so our first bit of feedback comes from the Akhenaten episode. Paul writes on Facebook, this was a fascinating listen. Looking forward to further podcasts on ancient Egypt. History is amazing. I agree. History is awesome. It's history is stories and stories are awesome. And I like stories about ancient Egypt. Egypt is a fascinating and mysterious place. And in the not too distant future, we're going to be we will have more Egypt episodes, including next up is going to be King Tut's murder. King Tut murder theory. (1:11:37)

All right. And then Claire Cappenham writes on YouTube, please do a full episode on the chronology of Joseph Moses in Egypt. I saw a documentary that suggested 1450 was a better date for the exodus than the later date, but I don't know how to judge the quality of the scholarship. I'd love to get Jimmy's take. (1:11:57)

So what Claire is referring to is the date that the exodus would have occurred. And there is a difference of scholarly opinion. Of course, skeptical scholars may say, oh, there never was an exodus. But I think there was. And I think there's good reason to think that. The question is when it happened. And there are sort of two major camps. (1:12:17)

One group says it happened in the 1400s BC. Another major group, and that's the traditional view. Another major group that's the more popular one today says it happened in the 1200s BC. I actually love biblical chronology, but my main area of focus thus far has been New Testament chronology. I know that really well. I'm presently doing research on Old Testament chronology, including the chronology of the exodus. (1:12:41)

And so I hope to do deal with that in the future. Then Aaron Wood writes on YouTube, an exodus episode would be great. I know that there are many secular scholars who deny that the exodus didn't even happen at all. So I would love to get some more information about the history of this time. (1:13:01)

By the way, I favor the early date for exodus. And as I mentioned, that is the traditional date, even if it's not the most popular one among scholars today. If you, we will do an exodus episode in the future. If you would like more information that I've written about it, Google Jimmy Akin exodus, and you'll come across some of the arguments for why I think, even from a skeptical perspective, we should conclude that yes, the exodus did occur. (1:13:26)

You can't just dismiss it. And then we have another comment, but I'll let you read that and respond to Jimmy. So Leon Caruthers on YouTube had made a comment on our astrology episode, and he had referenced some studies that suggested there were connections between life outcomes and the month you're born in. And I, in a previous episode dealing with his feedback, I said, well, I'm open to that, but I'd like to see these studies. (1:13:49)

Can you, can you point me to some? So he did. He linked a study from the United Kingdom, and he says in his new comment, it's data mining, not an experiment per se, but it's relevant to the question of how birth month or at least season might affect the patterns of our lives, even including the amount of education we seek, which could in turn be a factor of birth month combined with when our culture starts formal education. (1:14:20)

And I know that because I have a birthday that's kind of right on the edge of do we send him to school this year or wait till next year for first grade? Well, I took a look at the study and it's a UK study on season of birth, birth weight, pubertal timing, that is when you begin puberty, adult body size and educational attainment. And what they found is that birth season does have an impact on some of these things. Quoting from part of the abstract, they said individuals born in summer, June, July, August had a higher mean birth weight compared to those born in all other seasons. (1:15:00)

There is a general consensus that season of birth influences the risk of developing psychiatric conditions later in life. We aimed to investigate whether the risk of schizophrenia, bipolar affective disorder, and recurrent depressive disorder is influenced by month of birth in England to a similar extent as other countries. And they concluded that it was. Now, I was particularly interested because astrology doesn't so much have to do with your height as it does your personality, at least as it's classically done. So I was particularly interested in the psychological aspects of this. (1:15:39)

So I found a further study from this one that's on seasonal distribution of psychiatric births in England. And according to the abstract for this one, our findings provide support for the fetal programming hypothesis, refining and extending the impact that season of birth has on childhood growth and development. While other mechanisms may contribute to these associations, the findings are consistent with a possible role of in utero vitamin D exposure. (1:16:23)

So vitamin D is made by the skin in exposure to sunlight. That's why people from northern climates tend to be white because they need to absorb more sunlight to get the vitamin D out of it. And so you could see how seasons would have... because they have... if you're in northern or very highly northern or very low southern latitudes, you're going to have significantly more or less light in summer and winter. (1:16:50)

That's going to affect the amount of vitamin D the mother is making, which is then going to affect the amount of vitamin D the unborn baby is exposed to. And that could then set up these other things, including birth weights and timing of puberty and height and potential psychiatric disorders. So we're not talking... and Leon Carruthers acknowledges this... we're not talking planets are doing this to you. (1:17:16)

It's not like the position of Jupiter is doing this. This would be through mechanisms like the amount of heat and light that your mother is getting at the time you're in the womb. But it still does show that there can be some kind of seasonal correlations between when you're born, your birth month, and what some patterns in your life may be. (1:17:40)

So in Mysterious Headlines, we'll have links to both of those studies. So folks, that's it from us on this topic. (1:17:46)

These topics... actually, that's almost like a whole other second set of fascinating information and mystery right there. You get two of them in one show. So what did you think, though, about the mystery of Skinwalker Ranch? What's your theory? What do you think is really going on? Is it a hoax? A portal to another world? Let us know. (1:18:09)

Go to sqpn.com or to the Jimmy Akins Mysterious World Facebook page and you can leave a comment on the show that's linked there. You can send us an email to mysterious at sqpn.com or send a tweet to our Twitter account at mys underscore world or you could use the hashtag on Twitter of hashtag mysterious feedback. Any of those methods is a great way of getting in touch with us and letting us know, giving us your feedback on the show. (1:18:40)

Please, if you can, this is a great example of this episode of the sort of stuff we're doing that is unlike anything else out there, frankly, that I've been able to find. I mean, there are other shows that cover mysteries and that sort of stuff, but nothing like the way Jimmy does here. And so share the show with your friends. They're going to love it. And there's such a variety of topics. There's something for everyone. (1:18:57)

So please share the podcast with your friends and write reviews on iTunes or wherever you get your podcast. They all have ways of leaving reviews. That helps us grow our community of listeners, provides better feedback, gets it out to more folks and even more resources. Sometimes people write in with sources for Jimmy to use when he does some of his investigations. Yeah, like Leon did. (1:19:18)

Exactly. And we also want to thank our patrons for voting Skinwalker Ranch and for voting Copper Skull last week. Yes, exactly. So please help us grow this community and help support the show and reach more listeners. You can find links to all of the resources Jimmy mentioned from our discussion and links to those mysterious headlines on our show notes at sqpn.com slash mysterious. Until next time, Jimmy Akin, thank you for exploring with us our mysterious world. (1:19:48)

Thank you, Dom. And once again, I'm Dom Bettinelli. Thank you for listening to Jimmy Akin's Mysterious World on StarQuest. (1:19:55)

item.title: Stephen Lovekin 准将の証言 : 政府による UFO 隠蔽工作
item.content:encoded:
目次​

  1. 要約
  2. 詳細
  3. 時系列
  4. 主要関係者
  5. UFO の残骸を見せられた
  6. 情報源
  7. 文字起こし

AI 整理​

AI

アイゼンハワー政権下のUFO隠蔽工作

この情報源は、スティーブン・ラヴキン准将が、彼がホワイトハウス陸軍通信局に勤務していた1959年から1961年の間に、UFO現象に関する政府の秘密工作に直接触れたという証言をまとめたものです。

ラヴキン氏は、ロズウェル事件の破片と地球外生命体の遺体を目撃したこと、そしてアイゼンハワー大統領がUFOの目撃情報に個人的な関心を持っていたことを詳細に語っています。彼はまた、政府が一般市民に真実を隠蔽するために恐怖を利用していること、そしてフリーエネルギー技術を抑圧していることについても述べています。

全体として、この証言は、UFO現象に関する米政府内の深い秘密と、その情報がもたらす広範な影響に焦点を当てています。

AI

機密解除されたUFO情報に関する詳細ブリーフィング文書

本ブリーフィング文書は、スティーブン・ラヴキン准将（元ホワイトハウス陸軍通信庁勤務）へのインタビューに基づき、米国政府のUFO隠蔽工作に関する主要なテーマ、重要なアイデア、および事実をレビューするものです。

  1. 情報源の信頼性とラヴキン准将の経歴

スティーブン・ラヴキン准将は、1958年にジョージ・スクールを卒業後、軍に入隊。フィラデルフィアの私立共学予備校出身である。ペンタゴン内の無線周波数工学オフィスで勤務した後、1959年5月にホワイトハウス陸軍通信庁に入隊し、アイゼンハワー大統領およびケネディ大統領の下で勤務した。1961年8月に退役。彼の職務は暗号の扱い方を学ぶことであった。

ラヴキン准将は、情報に対する高度なクリアランス（トップシークレット、そしてさらにその上の段階）を与えられる訓練を受けていたことを強調している。「我々はトップシークレット以上のクリアランスを与えられるよう訓練されていた」と述べている。このことから、彼が極秘情報にアクセスできる立場にあったことが示唆される。

  1. プロジェクト・ブルーブックとUFO情報の管理

プロジェクト・ブルーブックは、彼のオフィスで「非常に公然と議論されていた」という。しかし、ブルーブックに記載される情報と、それ以外の「他の事柄」とが明確に区別されていた。

ブルーブックの情報の性質: ブルーブックに掲載された情報は「非常に科学的で、そこに載せるべき内容を知っている人々によって綿密に精査されていた」。これらの情報は「決して他の誰にも漏れることはなく、特定の軍事要員の使用のために設計されていた」。記載されたケースは「可能な限り真正なもの」であり、「立派な評判を持つ人々」からの報告に基づいていた。

非公開情報の存在: ラヴキン准将は、ブルーブックに掲載されていない「他の機関で使われている」写真が多数存在し、「おそらくそれらの写真は、彼らが見せていた写真よりも優れていたのだろう」と推測している。これは、政府がUFO情報を階層化し、特定の情報を選別して公開していたことを示唆する。

  1. ロズウェル事件の物質的証拠と地球外生命体

ラヴキン准将は、1959年頃、ペンタゴンの無線周波数工学オフィスで上官であるホラバード大佐（Lieutenant Colonel Holloman、あるいはHollabird）から、1947年のニューメキシコ（ロズウェル）墜落現場から回収されたとされる物質的証拠を見せられたと証言している。

物質の描写: 彼はその物質を「金属片のように見える」「物差しのような形をしていた」と表現している。また、「灰色の、ホイルのような」質感で、「8～10インチの長さ」だったと記憶している。「焦げ付いたように見えた」とも述べている。

暗号らしき模様: その物質には「解読不可能な」「暗号のようなもの」が刻まれており、ラヴキン准将はそれを「象形文字のように見えた」と表現し、さらに「動いているように見えた」と付け加えている。ホラバード大佐はこれを「指示の記号」と説明し、軍が「恒常的に」研究を続けるほど「極めて重要」であると強調した。

地球外生命体: 翌日の議論で、「地球外の遺体」が存在したことが明かされた。「3体または5体」であり、1体は「部分的に生きていた」と伝えられた。

  1. 政府の隠蔽と「恐怖」による情報統制

ラヴキン准将は、UFOに関する情報が厳重に管理され、漏洩を防ぐための強硬な手段が取られていたことを強調している。

キャリアへの影響: 「UFOについて話すことが、最も早くキャリアを台無しにする方法だと明確に伝えられた」と彼は証言している。これは、機密情報を取り扱う要員に対する強力な抑止策であった。

「消去」の脅威: 後にCIAとDIAに関与していたマットという人物から、「消去される」という脅しがあったことを聞かされたという。「彼らは、あなただけでなく、あなたの家族も追いかけるだろう」という言葉が伝えられ、この脅しは1947年から始まり、実際に実行されてきたとマットは語ったという。

恐怖による統制: ラヴキン准将は、政府がUFO情報を隠蔽し続けている最大の理由が「恐怖」であると結論付けている。「彼らがこれほど長く秘密にしてこられた唯一の理由は、恐怖によるものだ」。彼は、恐怖によってポジティブなものは何も生み出されず、最終的には「人間の魂と精神を堕落させる」と批判している。

  1. アイゼンハワー大統領のUFOへの関心と「軍産複合体」への懸念

ラヴキン准将は、アイゼンハワー大統領がUFO問題に個人的に深く関心を持っていたことを証言している。

落書きと興奮: アイゼンハワー大統領は、会議中に不満を感じるとUFOの様々な形を「落書き」していたという。彼はUFOの「形やサイズ、そして何がそれらを動かしているのか」に非常に興味を持っていた。UFOに関する情報を受け取ると「まるでD-Dayが再び起こっているかのように興奮し、命令を下した」という。

情報へのアクセス: 大統領は、ホワイトハウスの通信センターを通じてUFOに関する情報を継続的に受け取っていた。

コントロールの喪失: しかし、ラヴキン准将は、アイゼンハワー大統領がUFO状況に対する「コントロールを失った」と感じていたと考えている。これは、有名な「軍産複合体」に関する退任演説と関連付けられている。アイゼンハワーは「企業がこの国に害を及ぼす形で使われる可能性がある」と懸念していたという。彼は、自身が「十分に警戒していなかった」と感じ、あまりに多くの人々を信頼しすぎた結果、UFO問題が「最良の手に渡らない」と懸念を抱いていた、とラヴキン准将は解釈している。

  1. 地下施設とUFO対策

冷戦時代に建設された地下施設が、UFO問題にも関連していたことが示唆されている。

政府継続のための施設: ラヴキン准将は、マウント・ウェザー、フォート・リッチー、キャンプ・デービッド、および「コンクリート」というコードネームのウェストバージニアの施設といった、大統領や政府要人が核攻撃時に避難し、政府機能を維持するための地下施設について言及している。

UFO対策設備: これらの施設、特にマウント・ウェザーには「UFO問題に特に対処するための設備」があったと明言している。また、マウント・ウェザー周辺でUFOが「何度も」目撃されており、「UFOに対する標準運用指示」が存在したという。

レーダーロックオン: オハイオ州のライト・パターソン空軍基地や、カリフォルニア州、テキサス州、ワシントン州からも「レーダーロックオン」のケースが多数報告されており、これらは「真正な」ケースとしてブルーブックに記載されていた。

  1. 地球外の起源と高度な技術

ラヴキン准将は、UFOの地球外起源について確信を抱いていた。

スティーブン・ラヴキン准将の証言は、米国政府がUFO、特に1947年のニューメキシコ墜落事件に関する物理的証拠と地球外生命体の存在を認識し、これを国家安全保障上の最高機密として厳重に隠蔽してきたことを示唆しています。

しかし、ラヴキン准将は、この隠蔽は長続きせず、最終的には真実が明らかになる時が来るだろうと予測しています。また、アイゼンハワー大統領がこの状況におけるコントロールの喪失を認識し、その懸念が「軍産複合体」に関する警告に繋がったと解釈しています。

I think he intended for us to know that our futures were going to be dealing with this subject matter more and more. (0:10:31)

He did describe them as being symbols of instruction, and that's as far as he would go. But he did infer that the instructions, whatever they might have been, were something that was important enough for the military to keep working on on a constant basis. He made it quite clear that this was something that was of grave importance. We were in the basement of the Pentagon, and in those days, that was in 1959, there was a tremendous amount of security there in the basement of the Pentagon. Anybody who's worked there knows what I'm talking about. (0:11:16)

You could almost carry on an entire war in the basement, and no one else would know what was going on in the floors above, so that's how secure it was. I was working on top secret. I had gotten a secret, and by the time I finished the school, I had been given a top secret, but I was to be given one step higher than that. (0:11:39)

At that time, they didn't have a clearance specifically dealing with this problem. If you dealt with a problem, you got a Q clearance, which was a nuclear clearance. Maybe later on, they decided they were going to change that, but I remember that that was the big question. How are we going to give our security clearances to these people who have been through this course? (0:12:06)

There were probably 1,500 reported cases at that time that were, I guess you'd say, eligible to be printed or to be put in Blue Book. The findings that were put in there were highly scientific, and they were highly gone over by the people that knew what they wanted to put in there. This information was information that would never get out to anyone else, but it was designed for the use of particular military personnel. (0:12:47)

What was there was extremely exact and specific. These cases were as bona fide as they possibly could be. They were talking about people who had sterling reputations, either in the military or in civilian capacity in some form or another, but they were not taking any loose cannons. (0:13:13)

This was information that they thought was extremely accurate. In this country during the early 50s, numerous bases were built that would allow the President and Congress and VIPs to go in case of attack. That is to maintain the government on its level of being able to function and so forth. Mount Weather, Virginia was one of those. Fort Ritchie, Maryland was another. Camp David, Maryland in the Catoctin Mountains was another. (0:14:03)

There was another one in West Virginia at that time, which we only knew as Concrete. That was the code name. Mount Weather, for example, is underground. It is designed specifically to be impenetrable as far as then what we knew about atomic weaponry was concerned. But also, there was equipment up there and it was specifically told to me when I first came there, when I first went on tour there. (0:14:47)

Because we had to go through all these places where the President would go just to familiarize ourselves on what to do and how to do it. But there was equipment up there to deal specifically with the UFO problem. There was a standard operating instruction and I don't know what it was. That would have been out of my category of work. But there was a standard operating instruction on what to do with UFOs that had been sighted around Mount Weather. Not only on one or two occasions, but on numerous occasions from what I understand. (0:15:29)

They also had been sighted in West Virginia at the place I referred to as Concrete. Stories about radar lock-on, yes there were and several of those stories came out of Ohio. There was Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, but several others came from California, Texas, Washington from what I can recall. But I would say there probably were between two and three hundred cases of lock-on. And that's why those cases were in there, because they were authentic. (0:16:08)

Did I ever hear that we had ever picked up signals which could not be identified or if they could be identified, were they coming in from strange craft that perhaps had given us or put us under surveillance? And yes, I did hear that and I heard that from numerous, I wouldn't say numerous, but at least five, maybe six reports that wound up in Blue Book. And these, in fact, several of the reports had come in through pilots' radios. (0:16:47)

So whatever intelligence we were dealing with at that time knew how to deal with us, they knew how to communicate with us, but that they were of extraterrestrial origin, that was the belief. I was told that what they had there for us to deal with came from the New Mexico site, but there were other sites and there were other crashes. They did not say where. They were not pinpointed, but it was made quite clear that that was not the only site that they had gathered information from and also materiel. (0:17:29)

The Wright-Patterson Air Force Base was brought up on a number of occasions, that apparently there were more lock-ons at Wright-Patterson than at any other Air Force Base. Edwards Air Force Base was mentioned as an experimental station. (0:17:51)

And when I say mentioned in that context, I knew that it was mentioned in the area of testing whatever they had found. It was said that that's what was being done. Lock-ons had come from Edwards Air Force Base. I found that in Operation Blue Book. I was there at the same time that Philip Corso was there. When I first came to work for the President, I didn't meet him until probably a month and a half after I'd been on board. (0:18:28)

And at that time, it was a very formal meeting. In the councils of government, we must guard against the acquisition of unwarranted influence, whether sought or unsought, by the military-industrial complex. Right after that, I got an opportunity to travel a little bit with the President. We did some traveling towards Florida. He loved to play golf. And I had an opportunity to see him under fire, as it were, and how he would handle certain people that he didn't like. (0:19:10)

And when he did that, he would doodle. He was probably one of the world's best doodlers, and everybody would kid him. I wasn't in a position to do so, but the higher officers would kind of say little things every now and then. And he just would smile, and he'd keep on doodling, while on some of those occasions, he had just been given messages or just been given information pertaining to sightings or pertaining to information about UFOs. And I know that for a fact, because I was in the comm center, and I saw that information. (0:19:47)

And when he would do it, it would excite him beyond... he was just a kid. He would get so excited and give orders, like D-Day was happening all over again. He was very, very interested in shapes and sizes and what made them go. I know that. The White House itself has a huge comm center in the basement. It's run by the Air Force, but the Army's there. (0:20:22)

Every place where the President would go, including Camp David, has a comm center that deals specifically with presidential traffic. The President would continually, on an afternoon or an evening, would continually get fed information. And it wouldn't be coming from me. It would be coming, usually, from a warrant officer. Well, I'm not sure how that works, but that's the way it worked at that time. (0:20:52)

Usually, it was from a warrant officer. I saw a chief warrant officer who'd been in the Army for probably 30 years or more. And when he would get that information, he sometimes would close himself off and he would be alone for a while. And then he would call in whoever he needed to call in. But dealing specifically with UFOs, I can only remember on one or two occasions where that information came directly from the comm center to him. (0:21:23)

Most of the time it seemed to come, it was indirect. Most of that material, when it's passed through, it's for eyes only. (0:21:31)

And that means that if you have a direct interest in it, then you'll see it. If you don't, then you won't. You knew that there were sightings. You knew that there were new findings. If you'd been around the president long enough, you could just judge by his expressions what he was reading and what interested him. I mean, it's just something you knew from being around him. (0:21:57)

I would say that probably that was among his highest of interests at that time. Yes, indeed. It happened quite frequently. And I wouldn't dare say how many times, but it happened frequently. What happened was not one particular agency could handle dealing with the entire subject matter. Dealing from the engineering portion to sighting information to reporting it into Blue Book. The whole process of dealing with the UFO phenomenon. (0:22:39)

Could not be handled anymore by one agency. And so in order to keep it alive, and I guess as cheaply as possible, it was given to various and sundry parts of the government to work on. And I guess they thought that they could also keep the intelligence factor as secret as possible by giving agencies a little bit here and a little bit there. (0:23:09)

And that oftentimes is done with matters like this. But what happened was Eisenhower got sold out. Without him knowing it, he lost control of what was going on with the entire UFO situation. But I think he was telling us the military industrial complex will stick you in the back if you are not totally vigilant. And I think he felt like he had not been vigilant. (0:23:43)

I think he felt like he trusted too many people. And Eisenhower was a trusting man. He was a good man. And I think that he realized that all of a sudden this matter is going into the control of corporations that could very well be used in detriment to this country. We have been compelled to create a permanent armaments industry of vast proportions. The total influence, economic, political, even spiritual, is felt in every city, every state house, every office of the federal government. (0:24:26)

I think the frustration from what I can remember went on for months. He realized that he was losing control. He realized that the phenomenon of whatever it was that we were faced with was not going to be in the best hands. As far as I can remember, that was the expression that was used. It's not going to be in the best hands. That was a real concern. (0:25:02)

And so it has turned out to be. We recognize the imperative need for this development. Yet we must not fail to comprehend its grave implications. I would say that the government has done as good a job through the installation of abject fear, as good a job on this as they've done with anything within the time of the memory of modern man. I really believe they've done a job. (0:25:38)

It had been discussed with me on numerous occasions. (0:25:41)

Talked about what could happen to me militarily and what could happen to me even if I discuss this as a civilian. He discussed with me what possibly could happen should there be revelation. Is that what your question was? And he was talking about being erased. And I said, Matt, what do you mean erased? He said, yes, he said, you will be erased. I said, how do you know all this? (0:26:22)

Or something to that effect. And he said, I know. He said, those threats have been made and carried out. He said, those threats started way back in 1947. The Army was given, or the Air Force, excuse me, was given the absolute control over how to handle this. This being the biggest security situation that this country has ever dealt with. And there have been some erasures. (0:27:02)

He was very convincing when he said this. And he was in a position to know. He was much older than I, and he had been involved with the CIA and the DIA both. Well, then it wasn't the DIA, but he was involved with the CIA. And so he knew what he was talking about. And he wasn't, you know, he wasn't just kidding. So I guess fear has done it. (0:27:31)

I don't care what kind of a person you are. I don't care how strong or courageous you are. It would be a very fearful situation. Because from what Matt said, he said, they'll go after not only you, he said, they'll go after your family. Those were his words. And so I can only say that the reason they've been managing to keep it under wraps for so long is through fear. (0:27:56)

They are very selective about how they pull someone out to make an example of. And I know that's been done. You can't create anything positively through fear. Fear only degenerates the human soul and the human psyche. The human mind, if you will. And that will eventually go away. We have gotten so much momentum with the secrecy that has shrouded this subject matter that we're liable to wind up in a big fat crash. (0:28:36)

I don't think that collectively we are able, at least as far as I've been able to determine, and granted I'm not privy to the things that I would like to be privy to, but as I see it, when you propagate a lie and propagate a fear of the truth, you put yourself in a very vulnerable position. They've been doing it for a long time, so evidently they've known how to do it. (0:29:12)

But at some point in time, because of the interest I think that the media has taken, there will be people coming out speaking that have never thought about speaking before, particularly about Nellis and what's been going on there. I think because what would be revealed would totally destroy an economy that was designed by certain capitalists in this country a long, long time ago to maintain them and their corporations from here to eternity. (0:30:04)

And I think that oil has a special interest in seeing that it maintains its position where it is, regardless of what kind of pollution, regardless of what disastrous side effects may have occurred and continue to occur. (0:30:21)

I think that what we're dealing with is we're dealing with certain electromagnetic devices that are powered by sources that we just don't quite understand as of yet. Well, we're certainly not advertising them anyway. But that these sources would mean free power, and free power is something that corporations panic about, and I think this government panics about it. How are you going to tax free power, looking at it from a governmental point of view? (0:30:59)

And from everyone that I've talked to who knows something about this subject matter, they do believe that the sources of energy that keep these vehicles in propulsion are sources of energy that are just as free as free can be. And they don't cause any harm to the environment. They don't cause any footprints to be left anywhere. Given the fact that we're having a real question about how to deal with the high price of Arab oil right now. (0:31:34)

Bush is, as you know, is trying to insist that we go into some of the Arctic regions and take more oil out. I, for one, don't see that as an answer. I think that would be totally... with the global warming situation being what it is, that would just be another nail in our coffin. But at some point in time, and I don't know when that will be, but at some point in time, we are going to have to be faced with the sharing of this information that will allow us to have free energy, if you will. (0:32:21)

A graduate student in college dealing with physics understands that there are certain curves where this speed factor does not mean a thing. There are certain curve factors in space that time and space take on a totally new dimension. The government knows this. It's foolish for them to try to make the rest of us look like imbeciles and saying that this can't happen. Well, it can happen. (0:32:57)

I knew that we didn't have any vehicles of that kind, and I was 99.9% sure that the Russians didn't have any of that type either. So it certainly... there certainly was... at that point in time, there was no doubt in my mind that this vehicle was made at some other place than here on Earth. (0:33:20)

(2025-07-08)

item.title: 1942-09, UK : UFO に吸い込まれた 警備兵 UFO の体験
item.content:encoded:
前置き​

Preston Dennett の解説（Youtube 動画）を AI で整理。case 1/7 に相当。

目次​

  1. 要約
  2. 詳細
  3. 時系列
  4. 主要関係者
  5. ESP の発現
  6. 考察
  7. 情報源
  8. 文字起こし

AI 整理​

AI

アルバート・ランカシャーのUFO遭遇

この解説は、UFO研究者のプレストン・デネットによるアルバート・ランカシャーのUFO遭遇に関するもので、1942年の出来事とそれに続く一連の超常現象について詳しく説明しています。

第二次世界大戦中、レーダー基地の警備兵であったランカシャーは、未確認飛行物体に遭遇し、意識を失いました。当初、この出来事は夢として記憶されていましたが、25年後に始まった一連の超常現象が引き金となり、彼が物体に連れ込まれた記憶がよみがえります。

この証言は、英国における最も初期の船内UFO遭遇の一つとして、UFO研究者によって調査されました。ランカシャーは、誠実で知的な人物として評価されており、彼の経験が本物である可能性が高いとされています。

AI

アルバート・ランカシャーのUFO遭遇に関するブリーフィング資料

  1. 事例の概要と重要性

アルバート・ランカシャーの遭遇事例は、1942年9月にイギリスのニュービギン・バイ・ザ・シーで発生した、軍士官が関与する初期のUFO遭遇です。デネットはこれを「英国で最も初期のオンボードUFO遭遇」と呼んでおり、その点で非常に重要です。初期の研究者であるライオネル・ビア、ジェニー・ランドルズらによって研究され、複数のジャーナルや書籍で取り上げられています。

  1. 遭遇の詳細と時間経過

2.1. 1942年の出来事（当初の記憶と再浮上した記憶）

日時と場所: 1942年9月の寒い夜、第二次世界大戦中。イングランドのニュービギン・バイ・ザ・シーから約2マイル離れた秘密レーダー基地（クレスウェル・レーダー・サイト）で、27歳の陸軍歩哨兵アルバート・ランカシャーが任務中。

初期のUFO目撃: 「突然、水平線上に約350フィート離れた場所に、正体不明の黄色い光が現れた」。当初、ランカシャーは「ドイツ人が何を開発したのか？」と考え、UFOという概念は彼の念頭になかった。

物体の接近と光線: 黄色い光は「奇妙な丸い飛行物体」であることが判明。ランカシャーが歩哨箱に後退したところ、物体はさらに接近し、「アルバートは奇妙に警備ブースの外へ出るよう駆り立てられた」。直後、約1フィート幅の光線が彼に当たり、彼は気を失った。

意識回復と初期の解釈: 気を失った後、彼は数フィート離れた地面で目を覚ました。「彼は5分か10分横たわっていた。何が起こったのか分からなかった。」彼はUFOや「ミッシングタイム」という概念を知らなかったため、体験を解釈する術がなかった。しかし、「これは自然なものではないという明確な感覚」があり、「この物体はこの世界のものではない」と感じた。一時期、彼はこれを宗教的体験と考えた。

身体的影響: 遭遇後、舌に原因不明の「発疹」が現れた。後にこの発疹が遭遇と関係あるのではないかと推測する。

初期の夢: 遭遇から数年後、事件に関する夢を見始める。

  • 最初の夢: 「奇妙な飛行物体の中にいる自分」を見つけ、窓から海を見下ろしていた。白い制服を着た男が、彼を船に運び込まなければならなかったと告げた。
  • 2番目の夢: 再び船上にいて、赤い髪の短いスカートの女性に出会い、ゴーグルを渡された。

2.2. 1967年以降の超常現象と記憶の再構築

記憶のトリガー: 遭遇から25年後の1967年、一連の異常な超常現象が彼の記憶を呼び覚ました。

  • 寝室での光と顔の出現: 寝室のドアの上に「小さな針のような光」が現れ、それが「男の頭と顔の像」に変化した。この顔は「黒い髪、高い頬骨、細いひげ」を持ち、目は絶えず左右に動いた後、消え去った。
  • 職場での光と像の出現: 英国鉄道の信号手として勤務中、信号所の内部で「まばゆい光」が出現。その光の中から「白い大理石から彫り出されたような男の頭と肩」が現れ、すぐに消え去った。
  • UFO目撃: 同月、約300フィート離れた空中に「暗い色の物体」が点滅する赤いライトを伴って浮遊しているのを目撃。手を振ると、物体は停止し、ドーム型であることを確認。その後、高速で飛び去った。
  • 奇妙な光: 数日後、信号所の壁の一部が「説明のつかない緑色の光」で短く輝いた。
  • 共同UFO目撃: 1968年12月、別の信号手と共に、近くの大きな製粉所の煙突の近くに「明るく光る物体」がホバリングしているのを目撃。物体は煙突の周りを旋回し、ジグザグに動き、その後超高速で一直線に飛び去った。

ESPの経験: これらの出来事と並行して、「アルバートはいくつかのESPのエピソードを経験し始めた」。

失われた時間の記憶の回復: これらの超常現象が、25年前に失われた1942年の遭遇の記憶の「健忘症の壁を打ち破った」。彼は光線に打たれて気を失ったのではなく、実際には「光線に沿って歩いている」かのように空中に引き上げられたことを思い出した。

  • 搭乗と身体検査: 「小人サイズの男たち」に捕まえられ、船内に運び込まれた。彼らは白いスーツを着ていた。内部では、暗いゴーグルをかけた男に出会った。アルバートはテーブルやソファに横たわらせられ、青いドーム型の天井が見えた。隣のテーブルには「アジア系」の女性が横たわっており、「医者の帽子」のようなものをかぶりゴーグルをつけた男がその女性に身をかがめていた。この男はランカシャーに笑顔を向けた。アルバート自身は、ゴーグルをつけさせられ、外科用マスクをつけた人物によって身体検査された記憶がある。

記憶の欠落とUFO搭乗者の意図: その後、彼の記憶は途切れ、警備ブースの隣の地面で目覚めたことしか覚えていない。彼は、UFOの搭乗者がこの体験を「夢」として考えさせるか、あるいは「彼の意識から記憶を消去した」と感じた。

  1. 研究者による評価

報告の遅延: ランカシャーは、ベティ・アンド・バーニー・ヒル事件やUFOに関する情報を耳にするまで、UFO研究者にこの体験を報告するのを70代になるまで待った。

人物評価: 彼をインタビューした研究者の一人、エリック・リチャーズは、「ランカシャー氏は決して変わり者ではない。彼は完全に誠実であり、私に語ったことを全て明確に信じている。」と述べている。また、「彼は平均以上の知性を持っている」と評価し、「私の意見では、彼は本物の経験をしている」と結論付けている。

パターンとの一致: デネットは、「この紳士が宣伝を求めていないのは明らか」であり、数十年間秘密を守り続けたにもかかわらず、「ETコンタクトに見られる多くのパターン」を示していると指摘する。特に「超常現象や心霊現象をかなり経験したという事実が興味深い」と述べており、これは「UFOコンタクティーによく見られること」であるとしている。

  1. 主要なテーマとアイデア

初期のオンボード遭遇: 1940年代というUFO現象が一般に認識される前の極めて初期の段階で発生した、稀有な搭乗事例。

記憶の抑圧と回復: 遭遇直後の「ミッシングタイム」と、数十年後の別の超常現象によって失われた記憶が徐々に回復するプロセス。搭乗者による記憶消去の可能性。

超常現象との関連性: UFO遭遇が、その他の超常現象やESP能力の発現と同時に起こる、あるいはそれらを誘発するというパターン。デネットはこれを「UFOコンタクティーによく見られる」特徴として強調している。

身体的影響: 遭遇後の身体的異常（舌の発疹）の発生。

目撃者の信頼性: 目撃者であるアルバート・ランカシャーが、社会的な信頼性があり、誇張や虚偽の報告をしようとしていないことが、研究者によって高く評価されている。彼の体験が「真の経験」である可能性が高いとされている。

軍事基地周辺での発生: 秘密レーダー基地という軍事的に重要な場所での遭遇である点も注目に値する。

このブリーフィング資料は、アルバート・ランカシャーのUFO遭遇が、初期の発生時期、記憶回復の特異性、超常現象との関連性、そして目撃者の信頼性において、UFO研究上非常に重要な事例であることを示しています。

AI

タイムライン

1942年9月 (第二次世界大戦中)​

  • 場所: イギリス、ニュービギン・バイ・ザ・シーから約2マイル離れたクレズウェル・レーダー基地。
  • 出来事: 27歳の陸軍歩哨アルバート・ランカシャーが秘密レーダー基地で警備任務中に、海上に低い位置に unidentified な黄色の光が出現。
  • 出来事: 光は暗い雲に遮られた後、再び現れ、今度はより接近して、奇妙な円形の乗り物であることが判明。
  • 出来事: アルバートは監視小屋の外に出ることを強いられ、その直後、乗り物から幅約1フィートの光線が地面に照射され、彼に当たり、彼は浮遊感を覚える。
  • 出来事: アルバートは意識を失うが、実際には意識を保ったまま光線によって空中に引き上げられる。
  • 出来事: ピグミーサイズの、白いスーツを着た男たちに捕まえられ、乗り物の中に運ばれる。
  • 出来事: 乗り物の中で、彼は暗いゴーグルをかけた男と出会い、テーブルに横たわるよう指示される。青いドーム型の天井が見える。
  • 出来事: 別の検査台にアジア系の女性が横たわっており、ドクターの頭巾のようなものをかぶり、ゴーグルをかけた男が彼女の上に身をかがめているのを見る。この男はアルバートに微笑みかける。
  • 出来事: アルバート自身もゴーグルを渡され、外科用マスクをつけた人物による身体検査を受けたことをぼんやりと記憶している。
  • 出来事: 記憶が途切れ、次に意識を取り戻すと、彼は監視小屋の隣の地面に倒れていた。
  • 出来事: アルバートは自分が経験したことを理解できず、しばらくの間、それが宗教的な体験だったのではないかと考えた。
  • 出来事: この出来事の後に、説明のつかない舌の湿疹が発症する。

1942年以降の数年間​

  • 出来事: アルバートは、この事件に関する夢を見るようになる。
    • 夢1: 奇妙な乗り物の中にいて、大きな窓から海を眺め、白い制服を着た男が彼を船に運び込んだと告げる。
    • 夢2: 再び船の中にいて、赤い髪の短いスカートの女性に出会い、彼女がゴーグルを手渡す。

1967年 (事件から25年後)​

  • 出来事: 一連の異常な超常現象を経験し、これにより1942年の出来事の記憶が呼び起こされる。
  • 出来事: ベッドで横になっていると、寝室のドアの上に小さな点の光が現れ、それが男の頭と顔の像に凝縮する。その像は、黒い髪、高い頬骨、細いひげを持ち、目は絶えず左右に動いていた。数分後、像は消える。
  • 出来事: 職務中（ブリティッシュ・レイルの信号手として勤務中）、信号箱で存在感を感じ、数フィート離れた場所にまばゆい光が出現する。光の中から白い大理石の像のような男の頭と肩が現れる。数分後、光も像も消える。
  • 出来事: 同じ月、信号箱で、約300フィート離れた空中に hovering する、小さな赤いライトが点滅する暗い物体を目撃する。物体はゆっくりと目の高さまで下降し、アルバートが手を振ると停止する。赤いライトが消え、アルバートはそれがドーム型の乗り物であることを確認する。その後、物体は猛スピードで飛び去る。
  • 出来事: 数日後、信号箱の壁の一部が説明のつかない緑色の光で短時間光るのを目撃する。

1968年12月 (事件から26年後)​

  • 出来事: 信号箱にいると、隣の信号手から電話があり、近くの大きな製粉所の煙突のそばに明るく光る物体が hovering していると知らされる。
  • 出来事: 二人ともその物体を目撃し、物体は煙突の周りを旋回している。数分間観察した後、ゆっくりとジグザグに動き、その後猛スピードで一直線に飛び去る。
  • 出来事: これらの出来事と並行して、アルバートはESP（超感覚的知覚）の兆候を示すようになる。
  • 出来事: これらの奇妙な出来事によって、25年前の1942年の失われた時間に関する健忘症の壁が壊れ、アルバートは光線に引き上げられ、乗り物に乗せられた記憶を完全に思い出す。

1970年代以降（アルバートが70代になってから）​

  • 出来事: ベティとバーニー・ヒルの事件やUFOに関する話を聞いた後、アルバートは自身の体験をUFO研究者に報告する。
  • 出来事: 彼の事件は、イギリスで最初の「オンボードUFO遭遇」としてしばしば引用される。
AI

登場人物

アルバート・ランカシャー (Albert Lancashire):

  • 事件発生当時27歳の陸軍歩哨で、第二次世界大戦中に秘密レーダー基地を警備していた。
  • 後にブリティッシュ・レイルの信号手として働く。
  • UFOによる誘拐と、それに関連する一連の超常現象を経験した主要な証言者。
  • 誠実で、自分が語ったことを完全に信じているとUFO研究者によって評されている。
  • 数十年間、自分の体験を秘密にし、公の注目を求めていなかった。
  • 舌の慢性的な湿疹と、誘拐体験との関連性を疑っている。

プレストン・デネット (Preston Dennett):

  • UFO研究者。
  • アルバート・ランカシャーの事件を「オンボードUFO遭遇」と称し、その解説動画の文字起こしが情報源となっている。

ライオネル・ビア (Lionel Beer):

  • イギリスの先駆的なUFO研究者の一人。
  • アルバート・ランカシャーの事件を調査した人物の一人。

ジェニー・ランドルズ (Jenny Randles):

  • イギリスの先駆的なUFO研究者の一人。
  • アルバート・ランカシャーの事件を調査した人物の一人。

エリック・リチャーズ (Eric Richards):

  • アルバート・ランカシャーをインタビューしたUFO研究者の一人。
  • ランカシャー氏を「決して変わり者ではなく、完全に誠実」であり、「平均以上の知能を持っている」と評価し、「本物の体験をした」と結論付けている。

UFO乗員 (Pygmy-sized men):

  • アルバート・ランカシャーを乗り物の中に運び込んだ、白いスーツを着た「ピグミーサイズの男たち」。

UFO乗員 (Dark-haired man with goggles):

  • 乗り物の中でアルバートと出会った、暗いゴーグルをかけた男。 UFO乗員 (Asian-looking woman):
  • 乗り物の中で、別の検査台に横たわっていたアジア系の女性。

UFO乗員 (Man with skull cap and goggles/surgical mask):

  • アジア系の女性の上に身をかがめ、アルバートに微笑みかけた、ドクターの頭巾のようなものをかぶり、ゴーグルをかけた男。
  • アルバートを身体検査した、外科用マスクをつけた人物と同一人物である可能性もある。

UFO乗員 (Man in white uniform - from dream):

  • アルバートの夢の中で、彼を船に運び込んだと告げた白い制服を着た男。

UFO乗員 (Red-haired woman in short skirt - from dream):

  • アルバートの夢の中で、彼にゴーグルを手渡した赤い髪の短いスカートの女性。

隣の信号手 (Signalman in the next booth):

  • 1968年12月にアルバートにUFOの出現を知らせた同僚。二人で物体を目撃した。

ベティとバーニー・ヒル (Betty and Barney Hill):

  • アメリカで1961年に発生した、有名なUFO誘拐事件の被害者夫婦。
  • アルバート・ランカシャーが自身の体験を報告するきっかけとなった、彼らのケースに関する情報に触れた。
AI

ESP能力の発現…について敷衍して。

アルバート・ランカシャーのケースにおいて、ソースはESP能力の発現が、彼の失われた記憶の回復と後年の経験の重要な文脈にあることを示しています。

具体的には、彼の1942年のUFO遭遇の記憶は、当初は夢やフラッシュバックで断片的に現れたものの、完全には思い出されませんでした。しかし、25年後の1967年から始まる一連の「異常な超常現象」によって、この記憶が呼び起こされたとされています。

これらの後年の経験には、以下のようなものがあります。

  • 寝室のドアの上に現れ、男性の頭と顔のイメージに変化した小さな光。
  • 仕事中に信号所で感じた「存在」と、その後に現れた、白い大理石から彫られたような男性の頭と肩の形に凝縮したまばゆい光。
  • 空中に浮遊し、彼が手を振ると反応した、小さな赤いライトが点滅するドーム型の暗い物体。
  • 壁の一部が一時的に説明のつかない緑色の光で光ったこと。
  • 1968年12月に、別の信号手と共に、大きな工場の煙突の近くに浮かぶ明るく輝く物体を目撃したこと。

これらの出来事が進行する中で、アルバートは「いくつかのESPのエピソード」を経験し始めたと記されています。そして、ソースは、**これらの奇妙な出来事が、25年前の1942年に彼が経験した「時間の消失」を取り巻く健忘症の壁を「何らかの形で打ち破った」**と明確に述べています。これにより、彼は光の束によって空中に引き上げられ、小人サイズの男たちによって船に乗せられ、船内で身体検査を受けたという詳細な記憶を思い出すことができました。

さらに、UFO研究者のプレストン・デネットは、ランカシャー氏が「かなりの超常現象や心霊現象を経験した」と述べており、**「これはUFOコンタクティーによく見られることだ」**と指摘しています。これは、ESP能力やその他の超常現象が、UFOとの接触を経験した人々の間で頻繁に観察されるパターンの一部であるという一般的な認識を裏付けています。

したがって、ソースは、アルバート・ランカシャーのESP能力の発現が、彼のUFO遭遇の記憶の回復を促した超常的な一連の出来事の一部であり、UFOコンタクトのより広範な文脈における共通のパターンであることを示唆しています。

この事件を分析する​

以下、推測。

  • ESP能力の発現とされるものは、本人の思い込みや幻覚。

  • 彼の、

これらの奇妙な出来事によって、25年前の1942年の失われた時間に関する健忘症の壁が壊れ、アルバートは光線に引き上げられ、乗り物に乗せられた記憶を完全に思い出す。

という想起は、無自覚で創作した記憶。

  • 1968-12 の

出来事: 二人ともその物体を目撃し、物体は煙突の周りを旋回している。数分間観察した後、ゆっくりとジグザグに動き、その後猛スピードで一直線に飛び去る。

は自然発生した orb の目撃。

情報源 : 動画 (1:14:55)​

Have No Fear Seven Astonishing Onboard UFO Encounters

文字起こし

（以下は UFO 研究者の Preston Dennett の解説動画の文字起こしです。）

So let's just get started with our first case, which I call the on-board UFO encounter of Albert Lancashire. This is quite an early case. It took place in September of 1942 in Newbiggin-by-the-Sea, England. And this is an astonishing case because it does involve a military officer. (0:02:42)

He did not recall his encounter at first. It came back in dreams and flashbacks sometime after his encounter. But it's certainly an interesting and important case, if only because it's one of the earliest. And in fact, it has been called the earliest on-board UFO encounter in the UK. So that alone makes it significant. This case comes from pioneering English researchers Lionel Beer, Jenny Randles, and several others. (0:03:15)

It's appeared in several journals and books. It was a cold evening in September of 1942. This is the middle of World War II, by the way, as Albert Lancashire, a 27-year-old Army sentry guard, stood in his guard booth guarding a secret radar base located about two miles from Newbiggin-by-the-Sea in England. This is at the Cresswell radar site. He was armed with a loaded rifle and bayonet, but had been given explicit orders not to fire at any enemy aircraft, as this would give away the location of the secret base. (0:03:49)

Suddenly, an unidentified yellow light appeared low on the horizon over the ocean, just about 350 feet away. (0:03:56)

He stepped out of his booth and kept his eye on it when it became obscured by a dark cloud. Moments later, it, or another light, appeared, and this time it was moving even closer. So he thought to himself, what have the Germans invented now? He's not thinking UFOs. UFOs are the farthest thing from his mind. (0:04:21)

He's never heard of them. UFOs is a subject that hadn't made its appearance in the public consciousness quite yet. So as this thing approached, he saw that it wasn't just a light. It was a strange round craft of some kind. The light was coming from the rim of this craft. Now concerned that whoever was piloting this craft might see him, he stepped back into his sentry box. The craft then moved closer and lower. (0:04:45)

And this is weird. Albert now felt strangely compelled to step outside the guard booth. And no sooner had he stepped out when this object sent down a beam of light about a foot wide onto the ground, and before he could react, it swept towards him and struck him in the face. He automatically threw his hands up towards his face to protect himself. (0:05:09)

And as he says, I don't remember putting my rifle down, but I must have because it was loaded and had a bayonet attached. I didn't use the rifle because we weren't allowed to. I just put my hands up. So as this light hit him, Albert says he felt a strange floating sensation. And then he promptly blacked out. (0:05:33)

After an undetermined period of time, he woke up to find himself lying on the ground several feet from where he had been standing. He was pretty dazed and disoriented. And as Albert says, I lay there for five or ten minutes. I didn't know what had happened. Again, he'd never heard of UFOs, flying saucers, or missing time, so he really had no way of interpreting what he had just experienced. (0:05:59)

He did have the distinct sense that this was not natural. This object was not of this world. And for some time afterwards, he wondered if this might have been a kind of religious experience. He does say that sometime after this, he did develop an unexplained rash on his tongue. And he would later wonder if it had something to do with this encounter. But over the next few years, he started having dreams about this incident. (0:06:21)

In one dream, he found himself inside a strange craft, looking out a large window down at the ocean, while a man dressed in a white uniform informed him that he had had to carry him into the ship. In a second dream, he remembered that he was on the ship again, where he met a woman with red hair, wearing a short skirt, and she handed him a pair of goggles. (0:06:47)

So these were just dreams, but he connected it to this experience. 25 years passed, and this is when he experienced a series of unusual paranormal events, which somehow triggered his memory of being taken on board this craft all those years ago. This began in 1967. He was laying in bed one evening when he noticed a tiny pinpoint of light over the bedroom door. (0:07:14)

It quickly became brighter and larger, and coalesced into the image of a man's head and face. This head had black hair, the face had high cheekbones, a thin beard, the face was tilted upwards, and was immobile, though the eyes did move continuously from side to side, and after just a few minutes, it faded away and was gone. (0:07:39)

Needless to say, he found this very puzzling, but shortly after that, something else happened. He was on duty at his job. He was now working as a signalman for the British Rail, and he was in his signal box in the evening when he suddenly felt a presence, and suddenly a brilliant light appeared just a few feet from him. (0:07:58)

He said it was so bright, it hurt his eyes to stare directly at it, but seeing how strange it was, he couldn't help but stare. And then, coalescing out of this light, he saw the head and shoulders of a man, which he said looked like a statue carved out of white marble. There was no real detail to it other than a black line across the top of the head, and this image faded quickly away back into the light, and a few minutes later, the light itself faded out. (0:08:29)

So this was weird, and events were still in progress, because that same month, again, while at work in the signal box, he saw a dark-colored object with little red lights blinking on and off, and it was hovering in the sky about 300 feet away. (0:08:44)

It slowly lowered down to about eye level, at which point he's waved his arm at it, and the object promptly stopped. The red lights went out, and Albert could now see that it was, in fact, a dome-shaped craft. It immediately darted off at terrific speed, he said, and something else happened just a few days later. (0:09:09)

Again, at work in his signal box, he noticed a section of one of the walls glowing briefly with an unexplained green light. So all these weird things were going on, and one year later, there was another apparent UFO sighting. In December of 1968, he was in his signal booth again, when the signal man in the next booth down the way phoned him to alert him to the presence of a bright glowing object hovering near the chimney of a large mill in that area. (0:09:41)

They could both see it, and this object was circling around this chimney. They both watched it for just a few minutes, when it slowly moved away in a zigzagging movement, and then darted away at super high speed in a straight line. And while all this was going on, Albert started having some episodes of ESP. So somehow these weird events broke down the walls of amnesia surrounding his missing time encounter 25 years earlier in 1942. Albert now recalled that when this object had approached his guard booth all those years ago, and he felt compelled to step out and was struck by that beam of light, and he felt this floating sensation, he hadn't actually passed out. Instead, he recalled that he was drawn up into the air by this beam of light. (0:10:28)

He said it felt as if he was walking, quote, along the beam. Suddenly, he was seized by what he described as pygmy-sized men. He said they were wearing white suits, and they carried him on board this craft. Inside, he was met by a man with dark hair who seemed to be wearing some kind of dark goggles. Albert was made to lie down on a table or a couch, and looking up, he could see a blue domed ceiling. (0:11:02)

Next to him, he saw another table, another exam table, with an Asian-looking woman lying on it. He saw a man wearing what looked like, to him, a doctor's skull cap leaning over that table. He also wore goggles. This man turned and smiled at him in a welcoming way. Albert himself has vague recollections of being given goggles to put on his eyes, and being physically examined by a figure wearing some kind of surgical mask. (0:11:28)

At this point, his memory fades, and all he recalls is waking up on the ground next to his boot. He did have the sense that the UFO occupants had encouraged him to think of this experience as a dream, or in some way erased his memories from his conscious mind. But remembering all of this, he does wonder if his chronic tongue rash was somehow related to this experience. (0:11:55)

So again, he waited years. He waited until he was in his 70s to report this experience to UFO researchers, and he only did so after hearing about the Betty and Barney Hill case and hearing about UFOs. And again, his case is often cited as England's first on-board UFO encounter. One of the researchers who interviewed him, Eric Richards, says this, Mr. Lancashire is by no means a crank. (0:12:23)

He is absolutely sincere and clearly believes all he has told me. He is in himself definitely sure that they had him in that UFO in 1942 and did something to him. I would say he is above average intelligence. It is my opinion he has had genuine experiences. An incredible case, I think, by anyone's measurement. And it was investigated thoroughly. (0:12:53)

It's clear this gentleman is not seeking any publicity. He kept his encounter a secret for decades, and yet it does show many of the patterns we see with ET contact. Particularly interesting to me is the fact that he had quite a bit of paranormal and psychic events. So this is something we see a lot with UFO contactees. It's a really amazing case. And so is this next one. (0:13:14)

(2025-07-07)

item.title: 1975, Maine : Pamela Wimmer の UFO 乗船体験
item.content:encoded:
前置き​

Preston Dennett の解説（Youtube 動画）を AI で整理。case 2/7 に相当。

目次​

  1. 要約
  2. 詳細
  3. 時系列
  4. 主要関係者
  5. ESP の発現
  6. 情報源
  7. 文字起こし

AI 整理​

AI

パメラ・ウィマーのUFO遭遇：生涯にわたる交流

この資料は、UFO研究者プレストン・デネットが、著作「Humanoids and High Strangeness」で取り上げている「パメラ・ウィマー」と名乗る女性の生涯にわたるUFOとの遭遇経験について詳述しています。

パメラは、幼少期から成人期にかけ、複数回UFOを目撃しただけでなく、14歳の時にはグレイ型の地球外生命体に誘拐され、宇宙船内で身体検査を受け、地球を上空から目撃するという詳細な記憶を持っています。さらに、彼女の家族もUFOを目撃しており、現象が世代間で続いていること、そして遺伝子的な関連性の可能性についても言及されています。

資料は、これらの経験が彼女の人生に与えた影響や、その後のポルターガイスト現象、予知能力の発現など、奇妙な出来事が続いたことを伝えています。

AI

Pamela WimmerのUFO遭遇：生涯にわたる交流に関する詳細なブリーフィング

このブリーフィングドキュメントは、UFO研究者Preston Dennettによる「パメラ・ウィマーのUFO遭遇：生涯にわたる交流」からの抜粋に基づき、パメラ・ウィマー（仮名）のUFOと地球外生命体（ET）との生涯にわたる交流における主要なテーマ、重要なアイデア、および事実をレビューします。

  1. 遭遇の継続性と世代間のパターン

パメラ・ウィマーのUFO遭遇は、一度限りの孤立した出来事ではなく、彼女の人生を通して続く継続的なパターンを示しています。さらに、彼女の家族全体、特に彼女の父親、母親、妹、そして息子もUFOを目撃しており、「世代間の経験」であることを強く示唆しています。プレストン・デネットは、「これもまた重要なパターンである」と述べ、この側面を強調しています。この継続性と世代間の性質は、UFOとの接触が個人の経験を超えて、家族の系統に影響を与える可能性を示唆しています。

  1. 意識的な記憶とETとのコミュニケーション

パメラのケースの際立った特徴は、彼女が遭遇の多くを「完全に意識的に記憶しており、ETと会話することができた」という点です。特に1967年の誘拐事件では、グレイ型ETがテレパシーで彼女に「怖がらないで。怖がる必要はない」と語りかけ、彼女の不安を和らげようとしました。この意識的な記憶とコミュニケーション能力は、他の報告されるUFO遭遇ではしばしば欠如しているため、彼女の証言を非常に貴重なものにしています。

  1. UFOの目撃と物理的特徴

パメラは、生涯を通じて様々なUFOを目撃しています。

  • 1975年の目撃（22歳時、ドレスデン、メイン州）: 彼女の家の上空約40フィートに「直径200フィートの巨大な円盤型クラフト」が浮遊していました。それは「光沢のある銀色」で、「約20の舷窓を持つドーム」と「縁に沿って点滅する赤、青、緑、黄色の美しい明るい色のライト」がありました。特筆すべきは、「完璧に静か」で、子供たちを見るためかのように「傾いていた」ことです。この物体は「突然素早く回転し、光が混じり合ってぼやけ、その後稲妻のような速さで飛び去りました」。
